commtank.com CommTank Inc is a US storage tank contractor founded in 1997 in Winchester, Massachusetts, specializing in installation, removal, inspection and maintenance of underground and aboveground storage tanks across New England and the Mid-Atlantic. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it serves government facilities, hospitals, schools and industrial clients across 8 states. Its services cover the full tank lifecycle including UST and AST installation, leak testing, cathodic protection, soil remediation and emergency spill response. Led by founder Rick Connolly, it holds EPA, MA DEP, CT DEEP and NFPA certifications and runs its own field crews without subcontracting core work. It also provides Phase I and II environmental site assessments and SPCC compliance planning. The company has built a niche in high-barrier tank services requiring specialized licensing and regulatory expertise.

ined.fr INED is France's National Institute for Demographic Studies, founded in 1945 in Paris as a public scientific research institution under CNRS patronage and the world's largest demographic research center with 200 staff and 120 researchers. It holds a unique mandate as France's national population statistics authority, producing the annual Démographie de la France report and the monthly Population and Sociétés bulletin. Its 8 research departments cover mortality, fertility, migration, social stratification and global health, publishing over 300 scientific papers per year. INED maintains 20 plus demographic databases including the global Human Fertility and Human Mortality Databases with Max Planck and UC Berkeley. Led by Director Cyrille Schott, it partners with the UN, WHO and 50 plus international institutions while offering open access to all publications.
